# ModDotPlot Browser v0.9.3

**Note:** This file was generated by ChatGPT 5.6 Sol under the direction of Adam Phillippy.

v0.9.3 adds GitHub marks to both repository links and places a visible publication
warning beneath them. Publication figures and analyses should use the official
[ModDotPlot](https://github.com/marbl/ModDotPlot) CLI.

Every **Export data** action now produces the selected BEDPE or CSV file and a companion
`*.config.json`. Keep the config beside the source FASTA files (or edit its paths) and
run `moddotplot -c config.json` with the official develop version. The config maps the
current sequences and visible intervals, k-mer and cell-window settings, identity
thresholds, exact ordered colors, direction mode, and comparison layout. The official
CLI then recomputes that view with its publication estimator; it does not import or
claim numerical identity with the browser estimator.
